name: Dust Mask
description: A moulded paper shell with a wire nose clip. It was sold for sanding floors and it is not proud of where it ended up.

name: Surgical Mask
description: A pleated theatre mask with ear loops. Made to keep a surgeon out of a patient, not a patient out of a surgeon.

name: Sealed Goggles
description: Splash goggles with a foam gasket all the way round. They fog in a minute and you leave them on anyway.

name: Chemical Gloves
description: Long nitrile gauntlets off a laboratory bench. Nothing soaks through them and anything sharp goes through like paper.

name: Paper Coverall
description: A disposable white coverall with a taped seam. One snag and it is a bin liner with sleeves.

name: Half-Mask Respirator
description: A rubber half mask with a cartridge on each cheek. It seals on the chin and you can hear yourself breathing in it.

name: Hazmat Suit
description: A hooded suit in faded orange, taped at the wrists. Sealed, stifling, and it makes a person look like nothing anyone wants to meet.

name: Gas Mask
description: A full-face mask with a filter screwed into the cheek, surplus and older than it looks. The lenses are scratched to fog and it seals like the day it was issued.
